@@U04351@@
you hold your possessions forever,
with the sole proviso that they are indivisible,
and however much they are aggrandized by you,
they will pass undiminished to your eldest son.

@@U04353@@
It will be done at once, Majesty,
for the good of ourselves and the Empire.
My office will see to the engrossment,
the seal affixed and readied for your august signature.

@@U04355@@
And so I dismiss you, that each man of you
may contemplate this day’s great events.

@@U04356@@
(The SECULAR PRINCES go out, the SPIRITUAL PRINCE remains.)

@@U04358@@
(With pathos.)

@@U04359@@
The Chancellor has withdrawn.
It is the Bishop remains.
Warned by an inner voice,
he wishes to speak as a father
with deep concern for his son.

@@U04361@@
But, Lord Bishop,
what could possibly distress you
on this happy occasion?
Speak freely.

@@U04363@@
It grieves me, grieves me deeply at this hour
to see your sacred head in league with Satan.
Admittedly you sit safely on your throne,
or so it seems,
but in truth it is a mockery to God
and the Holy Father, who, once informed,
will exercise to the full extent of his powers
the ban of excommunication on you
translation:
@@U04351@@
你永远拥有你的财产，
唯一的条件是它们是不可分割的，
无论你如何夸大它们，
它们将原封不动地传给你的长子。

@@U04353@@
这将立即完成，陛下，
为了我们自己和帝国的利益。
我的办公室将确保全神贯注，
印章已加盖并准备好供您签署。

@@U04355@@
所以我解雇你们，你们每个人
可能会思考这一天的重大事件。

@@U04356@@
（世俗王子走了，精神王子留下来。）

@@U04358@@
（带着悲情。）

@@U04359@@
总理已退出。
这是主教的遗骸。
内心的声音警告着，
他希望以父亲的身份发言
带着对儿子的深切关心。

@@U04361@@
但是，主教阁下，
什么可能会让你感到困扰
在这个欢乐的时刻？
畅所欲言。

@@U04363@@
这让我悲伤，在这个时刻让我深深悲伤
看到你神圣的头颅与撒旦勾结。
诚然，你安全地坐在你的宝座上，
或者看起来是这样，
但事实上这是对上帝的嘲弄
圣父一旦通知，
将充分行使他的权力
对你的逐出教会禁令
